# Citation-style attribution

`bmt_vancouver.csl` is a local adaptation of the repository’s PLOS CSL, originally authored by Sebastian Karcher with Patrick O’Brien as contributor. Original credits and CC BY-SA 3.0 are preserved. The adapted style remains **CC BY-SA 3.0**, excluded from the project MIT/CC BY 4.0 grants.

Changes: BMT-specific identity/documentation; comma-space citation groups; journal-year punctuation and compact volume:pages, checked against the official BMT Vancouver examples. It is a project adaptation, not a publisher-issued citation style. No publisher template, proprietary font or full guideline PDF is redistributed here.

License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/ .
